## Credited prior answer
Matthias Franz's published Big polygon spaces construction realizes the maximal nonfree syzygy order floor((r−1)/2) over Q for every requested torus rank r≥5. Proposed disposition: already_solved, 0/5 author turns. This is source reconstruction and verification, not a new solution.

The original OWR question is checked against its full rational-coefficient context and the Allday–Franz–Puppe rank bound. Odd ranks use equilateral big polygon spaces; even ranks use the additional S³ factor. The compact connected orientable smooth examples have effective rank r and meet the source's finiteness hypotheses.

## Verification and qualifications
The corrected 2023 author version of the IMRN 2015 paper controls the calculation, with Franz–Huang 2020 as corroboration. The source rank typo, Morse sign/minimum wording and corrected degree shifts are retained explicitly. The relevant geometric, equivariant, Koszul and product proof chain was independently checked; no general-length classification is silently substituted for it. No minimal-dimension, integral-coefficient, positive-characteristic or novelty claim is made.

All 11 frozen author files and five independent review files are unchanged; three additive wrappers provide portable verification. The 358,064 author assertions and 983 independent symbolic controls pass. Finite tests support the written proof and do not establish arbitrary-rank topology by enumeration. Work and review are AI-assisted, not peer review.

The integration starts from fresh main and preserves WIP 5ba83eccde1e5a5655d199fc3abb47a277f82b31 as its second parent. Only this target folder and its own QUEUE status cell change; the count stays 0/5. Source PDFs are linked/hash-bound rather than redistributed. Draft only; no merge or release.
